description_en: Queries the details of a speech corpus, including the broadcast voice, corpus type, and volume
description_zh: 调用该接口查询语料详情，包括语料的播报声音、语料类型和音量大小等
name: QuerySpeech

parameters.help_en: The speech corpus ID. The Data field returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html is the speech corpus ID
parameters.help_zh: 语料ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html成功后返回的**Data**字段为语料ID
parameters.name: speech_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The details of the speech corpus

AudioFormat.description_en: The audio format. Only wav, mp3, and amr formats are supported

BizCode.description_en: The business identifier of the speech corpus. When a device calls multiple speech corpora for combined broadcast, this identifier specifies which corpus to broadcast
BizCode.description_zh: 语料标识，当设备调用多个语料进行组合播报时，通过该标识播报指定的语料

EnableSoundCode.description_en: Indicates whether the sound code is enabled

AdditionalDuration.description_en: The duration of sound code playback after the speech corpus finishes playing. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15
AdditionalDuration.description_zh: 语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15

SoundCodeContent.description_en: The marketing content of the sound code, such as the URL of product details
SoundCodeContent.description_zh: 声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等

SpeechType.description_en: The type of the speech corpus, which can be a custom corpus or a common corpus
SpeechType.description_zh: 语料类型，分为自定义语料和常用语料

Text.description_en: The content of the speech corpus

Voice.description_en: The broadcast voice of the speech corpus

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.

false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
